metadata.description: Economy decision point: after clearing the Small Blind you hold $6 and the shop offers Jolly Joker ($5) and Wily Joker ($5). Buying leaves $1 (no interest); leaving keeps $6, which pays $1 interest at the next clear and still lets you buy later. This is a planning trade-off, not a single-step score maximization.
metadata.offers_seed_note: seed 7 deterministically yields jolly_joker + wily_joker (both Common $5)
